controls._doc: Filled controls, ADR-043. state is the one fill for a selected segment, a toggled button and an on tile; state_ink is its glyph. knob and knob_ring draw a slider handle; the active track is state. Emphasis, the one strong fill a view may keep, is ink on window and is not repeated here. sheet is the opaque surface of a sheet such as the save changes sheet, in every mode; destructive_text, destructive_text_dim and ember_dot are text and graphic colours measured on it (4.5:1 for text at rest, hovered and pressed; 3:1 for the dot). menu_heading (section labels, descriptions), menu_shortcut (shortcut caps) and menu_disabled (disabled rows) replace opacity of the ink in menus: 4.5:1, 4.5:1 and 3:1 on the menu and its hover row. section_label is the sidebar and section heading (LIBRARY, CALENDARS), 4.5:1 on the window, content and card surfaces and under a hover wash.

lumaui._doc: LumaUI (luma-next-70, 25 Sep 2026). Colours become @define-color luma_<role> in every appkit token sheet (frost and glass take light, high contrast takes its own map); metrics and motion become CSS custom properties --lumaui-* on :root and constants in luma_appkit/lumaui_tokens.py. A design change is a change here, then scripts/developer/generate-luma-platform-tokens.py. oklch sources from v70 are noted in _source.
lumaui._source: v70 CSS: --cat-* hues at oklch(.93 .045 h)/(.42 .12 h) light and (.34 .065 h)/(.88 .07 h) dark (6.2-8.2:1 measured); count accent oklch(.52 .15 250); --lui-danger oklch(.55 .19 25) light, (.7 .17 25) dark; danger fill oklch(.64 .19 25) to (.56 .19 25); --good, --love, --chip, --chip-edge, --pop, --sh-float, --bar, --bar-edge, --acc-ink, --card-sky oklch(.2 .035 255 / .42).

motion._doc: Read off v70: --ease and --spring, hover/press 120-150ms, morphs 260-350ms, toast in 300ms spring from 12px below, dialog fade 160ms and move 360ms spring, scrim 200ms, drawer 260ms, nudge 300ms. Reduced motion swaps movement for a fade of reduced_fade_ms.

structure._doc: F2 structure parts (v70 lDP, lFoot, lSideBtn, lTHead, lTrail, lModes, .lcorner, lMenu). Each group becomes --lumaui-<group>-<key> (px unless the key ends in _pct) and luma_appkit.lumaui_tokens.STRUCTURE. Surfaces: well (recessed fields and the mode switch) and bar (the floating corner pill) are colours above.

sidebar._doc: The navigation sidebar (v70 ?app=contacts, ?app=memos) stands on the window's frame, not in an island. width is its outside, from the window edge to the content island; inset is the rows' distance from the window edge and from the island, gutter the window body's own share of it: none, since the body drops its left gutter while a frame sidebar is shown (v70 .isle margin 0 8px 8px 0), so the sidebar spans 0 to width and pads its own inset. Rows are 50px with a 34px round face.

toolkit_palette._doc: libadwaita's colour names and variables in the Luma design, and the Frost and Glass materials, rendered into src/luma-platform/appkit/lumaui-palette.css by generate-luma-platform-tokens.py (ADR-052). A value '{group.key}' is that token. Moved here from patches/libadwaita (0001, 0019, 0042) so the design has one authority; the toolkit sheet's shadow bases named lumaui_ink_<rrggbb> carry their value in their name.

action_center._doc: v70 .fbar/.lac2/.lac/.lacsplit and Charlie's reply: bar 16 round, 4 padding, 36 controls at 12 (concentric), the editor 720 wide at 20, capped at the island less 20 above, its text 132 tall and at most 40% of the window, a 22-round sheet on a phone.
action_center._v71_doc: v71 (2026-09-30): on a phone every bar control is 48 at 20, the bar 6 all round at 26, 34 above the foot, 2 between controls, icons 20; a toggled control is the raised chip. The bar grows: a panel above the row in the same glass, the grown width the phone less 12 a side or min(380, window - 24) in a window, 6 between panel and row. Menus, confirms and sheets on a phone take the bar's frame: 16 a side, 34 up, 26 round, a menu up to the height less 140, a sheet less 120. Scrollers behind the bar end 20 above it.

selection_bubble._doc: v70 .selbar and lBubble: 12 round, 4 padding, 32 buttons at 8; 10 above the selection, flipped below when that would come within 12 of the top; kept 8 inside the host.

file_card._doc: v70 lFile (.lfc): 300 x 60 at 16, the face a 44 square (an app icon 40, a picture cropped at 10), Open 28 at 9 with the app's 16 icon; the mini card 240 x 48 with a 34 face.

mini_card._doc: v70 .lmini: the owning app's card, the file card's size family; a person card 320 wide with its actions under it.

account_card._doc_recessed: v70 .cmecard: 6 above (the sidebar list's 4 plus its own 2) and nothing below, since v70's 6 collapses into the next heading's 12; the row inside is a sidebar row, recessed_row_height tall.

card._doc_heading_line_height: Whole pixels (GTK allocates no fractions): v70's .ccard h6 line box is 16.675 px (11.5 px at 1.45); 1.3913 makes it 16, rounding down so that with rows rounded up (49.525 to 50) a card's first and last rows stay within a pixel or two of v70 (lumaui-deviations.md, whole-pixel lines).

place_search._doc: v70 .lsug/.lsugi: the list 6 above the field, 14 round, 4 padding, rows 42 at 10; at most five places.

field._doc: v70 lField (.lfld): a label over a 38-tall recessed well at 12, 6 between; the hint 8 under it.

message_bubble._doc: v70 --lbub-*: 18 round, 6 where one sender's run joins, 9/13/10 padding, 14/1.45 text.

status_pill._doc: v70 .onl2: a 22-tall well pill, 8 inside, 7 round; a 7 px dot that glows 6 px; 11.5/600 label.

hero_field._doc: v70 .chero h1 and .cname: the hero title (30/700) that becomes a 320-wide well at 10 when it is edited, the person's hue in a 2 px ring around it. Being edited it is edit_height tall at edit_size (v70 .cname, 700 26px), set on the title's own 43.5 line: edit_margin_top above it and edit_margin_bottom below. margin_top and margin_bottom are the title's own (v70 .chero h1 margin 16px 0 4px), so apps don't restate them.

text._doc: v70 body: every label is 13px at 1.45 unless a type role says otherwise; a label that sets only its size keeps the 1.45. Line heights here are CSS's (a multiple of the font size); GTK multiplies the font's own line (ascent plus descent, font_line_ratio of the size for Figtree), so the generator divides by it.

fact._doc: A labelled fact (FactRow) whose value is being edited: a 30 px field, 8 round, on the island's own surface (v70 .crow2 input).

scroll._doc: v70 scroll fades: anything that scrolls fades out its top 22 px once scrolled more than 2 px (.is-scrolled); a list clipped at a card's foot fades its last 24 px (Contacts' Together, .ctog .tgl).

window._doc: v70 Solid material (.iwin): the frame is a gradient from window_top to window_bottom, and the content island is set into it (island_out, island_lip, island_edge, island_rim, island_shade), 12 round. v70 --isle-out is a 1 px ring in dark (island_out) and a lit 1 px lip below in light (island_lip). gutter is the frame's margin round the islands (v70 .isle margin 0 8px 8px); a frame sidebar takes the left one's place.
window._doc_frame: v70 .iwin, measured (W): the window is 20 round with --sh-win and --rim (colours: lumaui.colors window_*). The title row (.tbar) is 46 tall; the identity sits 14 from the left edge: icon 22 (6 round), name 13.5/600 at -0.01em, chevron 14, 9 between. The window controls (.wctl) are three 30 px squares, 9 round, 2 apart, 8 from the top and 10 from the right edge, glyphs 14 in frame ink-3; hover is fill-2 with frame ink, Close's is window_close_hover with white; keyboard focus is v70's 2 px accent ring 2 px out. v70 has no inactive, pressed or maximized look of its own: an inactive window, a pressed control and a maximized window look as they do at rest. The controls fold away at phone width (v70 .win.phone .wctl), controls_hide_max_width and below.

hue._doc: v70 people and things carry a hue (0-360): their face, the wash behind their card and the icons of what you share with them. OKLCH lightness, chroma and alpha per role; the kit turns them into colours (lumaui.hue_class).

lit_header._doc: v70 .mlight and .mwash: the face photo blown up 260%, blurred 70 px and saturated 1.5, 160 above the island and 520 tall, faded out from 30% to 85%; under it a 380-tall wash of the person's hue.

appearance_metrics._doc: Numbers that differ by appearance: a raised chip brightens on hover in dark and dims slightly in light (v70 .lstk:hover); sidebar rows and headings on a light frame are 600, 500 on a dark one (v70 light Solid and Frost :is(.si, .sh) 600).

high_contrast._doc: High contrast does not tint: parts keep their shape and take the window's ink, ground and accent. Anything not listed takes @window_fg_color. Media and sky roles keep their dark values: they sit over pictures, not the window.

frost._doc: v70 Frost, measured in light (Luma's Frost is one light appearance: the kit forces the light scheme). The frame is smoked glass lit from the top (window_glow) with off-white ink; the window takes v70's dark --sh-win and --rim (the frost-light .win cascade), four layers, no glow; the island is ringed dark outside (island_out) and lit inside (island_edge). These override the light family in the Frost sheet for the frame's and island edge's roles only (W); the island's own colour and what sits on it are the material's.
